sources.name: Modified Omegaton Fast Aid Pack
sources.description: Doctor Jagaar Ivel Dithaal was an infamous makeshift engineering and self-proclaimed genius. He wanted to modify the StimGene Pulse System on a standard first aid kit in an attempt to extract information from the “xeno-energy patterns” that he claimed were present inside the altered genes of all mutants on Calypso. By planting these modified versions inside mutant areas he hoped to gain proof for his theory. News of his experiments leaked out and Omegaton Industries were enraged at having their products spread out amongst mutants. The experiment was shut down and Dr. Dithaal was arrested and sent to a mental correction institution, many of his modified Fast Aid Packs are however still unaccounted for. On very rare occasions these tools find their way back into human hands. The modified versions appear to be fully functional and are very efficient, even though Omegaton Industries strongly advice people not to use them.

sources.name: Adjusted Genesis Star Excavator
sources.description: Even though Genesis Star Interstellar discourages unauthorized tampering with all of their products, it didn’t stop the tinkering miner Bubba Backhammer. His philosophy is that all tools can be adjusted for more efficient use, and if you bought it you own it and can do whatever you want with it, much to the general displeasure of most product manufacturers. sources.name: Genesis Star Earth Excavator ME/01
sources.description: Genesis Star Interstellar is the proud designer of this mineral extraction tool. It utilizes a combined laser and particle beam to extract ore from underground deposits. This type of hardware is necessary for exploiting natural mineral resources, and it has been the task of Genesis Star to bring this highly vital product to the market. To function, this tool first requires target data from a Claim Rod, and such data can only be obtained using a separate mineral detector of an inferior brand. Fortunately this excellent piece of multi-compatible hardware can compensate for any lack of quality in these other products, giving the user of this product a very reliable personal mining tool. Point the tool towards a Claim Rod marking your mineral deposit and press the assigned action button to extract ore.

sources.description: This mineral detector was originally developed by Omegaton Industries to find new mineral deposits. It’s designed for seismic surveys using the Omegaton Seismic Bomb. When the bomb has been remotely detonated the tool can pick up signals from various types of ore hidden deep under the ground. This tool can then be used to mark the site and generate a legal documentation of the find to verify the ownership of the site. It’s always necessary to claim the find before an excavation can be initiated. Excavating ore from a mineral deposit requires a mineral extraction tool, which must be purchased separately.
